purpose_zh: 记录本作品材料候选成立所必需的原文条件、量词与对象范围，以及重计边界与作者未展开之处。只陈述原文事实与位置，不对作者数学作独立正确性判定，不改写任何式子，不补端点或假设。

form_functions.content: sigma_1 and sigma_2 non-negative, smooth, compactly supported, radially symmetric

there exist sigma_1^epsilon satisfying H2-H3 with Sigma^epsilon = sigma_1^epsilon star sigma_1^epsilon, and for every R > 0 the sum of the L^{3/2} norm of (Sigma^epsilon - |x|^{-1}) restricted to |x| <= R and the L^infinity norm of the same difference restricted to |x| > R tends to 0
form_functions.scope_note_zh: 两种不同拓扑的混合：局部 L^{3/2} 承受 |x|^{-1} 在原点附近的弱奇性，远场 L^infinity 控制尾部。若材料把该假设记成单一 L^p 范数收敛，即偏离原文。

form_functions.content: the L^2 norm of u_h and the quantity E^{h}_{0,+} (which uses the positive part of the potential term) are uniformly bounded in h

there is a mass interval I with non-empty interior such that for every M in I and every positive radial minimizer Q_M of K_M the conclusions of Lemma 2.5 hold, with a constant nu depending on Sigma, omega, M, Q
form_functions.scope_note_zh: 该定义是条件式的；其非空性正是 Proposition 2.11（d=3）与 Proposition 2.16（d=1）的内容。不得把定义本身当作已证结论。

function_spaces.space: energy space of the wave part

structural_constraints.content: I_M uses norm(u)^2_{L^2} <= M; J_M and K_M use equality to M; the mass is not normalised to 1
structural_constraints.scope_note_zh: Theorem 2.1 is stated for every M >= 0; Theorem 2.8 additionally requires norm(u0)_{L^2} = norm(Q)_{L^2} for the perturbation (752), which the authors discuss as an assumption they do not remove (783-788).

structural_constraints.content: omega in R in the solitary-wave ansatz; the Euler-Lagrange multiplier satisfies omega > 0 at any minimizer with I_M < 0
structural_constraints.scope_note_zh: sign convention: the equation is -1/2 Delta Q + omega Q - kappa (Sigma star Q^2) Q = 0 (505-507); positivity of omega is derived, not assumed.

structural_constraints.content: Q and Psi real valued; u complex in the evolution; the linearisation splits u = f + i g with f, g real and uses the two real quadratic forms for the nonlocal L_+ and for L_-
the considered ground states are positive, radially symmetric and radially non-increasing; Lemma 2.5 and Definition 2.6 are formulated only for such minimizers
the Schrödinger part is dispersive (i partial_t u), the wave part is hyperbolic (partial_tt psi - c^2 Delta_z psi); stability statements are one-sided in t, sup over t >= 0

epsilon in Proposition 2.13 and Section 8; lambda, mu in the two-parameter construction; h in Appendix B; the perturbation sizes epsilon, eta(epsilon), delta(epsilon) in Theorem 2.8; the speed c and its interplay with the size of chi_0

eta(epsilon) and delta(epsilon) are uniform in c (772); epsilon_0 in Proposition 2.13(i) depends on the chosen sequence while epsilon-bar_0 in (ii) is uniform over sequences (854); the coercivity constant nu(Sigma^epsilon, Q^epsilon, omega^epsilon) converges to nu^0 but the rate depends on the sequence (849, 854); how small epsilon-bar_0 must be depends on M (857)
structural_constraints.scope_note_zh: 这些都是原文明确的依赖关系，材料若省略会把条件性结论误表述为一致结论。

quantifier_and_object_boundaries.quantifiers_zh: 对每个 M >= 0：(i) I_M 可达；(ii) I_M = J_M = K_M；(iii) 存在 M0 >= 0 使 M in [0,M0] 时 J_M = 0、M > M0 时 J_M < 0 且在 (u,psi,chi)=(u,psi,0) 处可达，u 非负、径向、非增，且 (u,psi) 解 (soliton)-(wave_soliton) 对某 omega > 0，psi = Gamma sigma_1 star |u|^2 非正，u 属 Schwartz 类；(iv) d >= 2 时 M0 > 0；(v) d = 1 时 M0 = 0
quantifier_and_object_boundaries.not_stated_zh: 唯一性未证（576-580）；minimizer 的严格正性与径向单调性作者归功于 Ma-Zhao（580, 1281-1300），未在本篇证明。

quantifier_and_object_boundaries.not_stated_zh: 未给出轨道唯一性；结论是关于调制后的单一参考态 Q，而非基态流形。

quantifier_and_object_boundaries.quantifiers_zh: 对每个 epsilon > 0 存在 delta_epsilon > 0；结论是关于集合 S_M（全体质量 M 的基态）的 inf 距离，sup over t >= 0
quantifier_and_object_boundaries.not_stated_zh: 不给出对单一轨道的接近性（602-606 明确讨论此弱点）。

quantifier_and_object_boundaries.quantifiers_zh: 对任意 u0 in H^1_x、psi0 in L^2_x Hdot^1_z、psi1 in L^2_x L^2_z，存在唯一整体解，u in C^0([0,+infinity); H^1_x)，psi in C^0([0,+infinity); L^2_x Hdot^1_z) 交 C^1([0,+infinity); L^2_x L^2_z)
quantifier_and_object_boundaries.not_stated_zh: 只正向时间 t >= 0；反向时间未陈述。

non_counted_context_zh: Section 1 的物理动机与无量纲化讨论（105-371）以及 Appendix C 的量纲分析（2780-2895）为背景，不含定理。
Section 2.3 的分解恒等式 (decomp_W)（656-661）与 Remark 2.3 是证明工具与说明，不是独立结果。
1-102 行为 class 选项、宏定义、作者信息与摘要；2896-2900 行为 backmatter 与书目命令。

owner_conditions: Keep particle dimension d distinct from environment dimension n>=3. H2 form functions are nonnegative smooth compactly supported and radial; H3 adds nonincreasing sigma1.

Admissibility Definition2.6 quantifies over a mass interval of nonempty interior and every positive radial minimizer, with coercivity constants allowed to depend on mass/potential/ground state. No general uniqueness inferred.

Old2153 is Proposition2.13(i) only: original literal locator2.13-i, statement835-851/proof1743-1859 and original specific H3 judgment remain. Secondary selects common header+item(i)835-842; full context is not wider adoption.

New Proposition2.11/8.2 construction in d3: distinguish preliminary directly truncated potential2051-2053 from actual autocorrelation construction2088-2112. Normalize integral alpha=1/sqrt(C), take epsilon=lambda*mu fixed and m in(mu0^-1*M,lambda0*epsilon^-1*M). The same fixed potential serves the interval; no claim of uniform coercivity constant over it.

New support includes Proposition2.13(ii) proof1861-1919 and Lemma7.1, rather than treating them as already adopted through old wide context. Lenzmann/Newton spectral kernel and DAvenia-Squassina coercivity and the Riesz convolution identity are named inputs, not recounted units.

Theorem2.2 concerns the full set of ground states. Theorem2.8 concerns the chosen phase/translation orbit conditionally on admissibility and equal mass; c-weighted wave-velocity norm, c-uniform eta/delta and the equal-mass restriction are preserved.

The speculative d2 subsection does not remove d2 from the earlier general-d existence/set-stability theorems. Its Questions1-3 and Conjecture1.2 remain open; exponential stopping is not established by orbital stability.

AppendixA: mixed time/space norm matching under smooth convolution, Banach contraction and mass/energy continuation; no separate H2. AppendixB: Lions-Paul Wigner/Husimi compactness, weak wave equicontinuity, compact translated smooth-kernel force tests and kinetic-tail estimate; the added smooth-wave transfer is below separate H2. AppendixC is dimensional context.
